themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and South America are ramping up campaign machinery, negotiating tactical alliances, and maneuvering against establishment rivals. From Vox fighting for dominance in Spanish regional elections to AfD's program debates in Germany and LLA's electoral reform push in Argentina, nationalist forces are aggressively positioning for power.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Nationalist parties in Germany, Spain, and the UK are escalating rhetoric around mass deportations and welfare chauvinism. Leaders are explicitly demanding 'remigration' policies, national priority for citizens in public benefits, and severe restrictions on foreign students and non-citizens.
